description: geoservices2.civis.bz.it: emergency and critical facilities datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoservices2.civis.bz.it. Coverage: the area served by geoservices2.civis.bz.it. The listing groups 4 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about emergency and critical facilities; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Distretti dei Vigili del Fuoco; Collocazioni dei Vigili del Fuoco Volontari; Zone di competenza dei Vigili del Fuoco; Servizi di Soccorso e Vigili del Fuoco - zone di competenza e collocaz. Formats seen: WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support emergency planning and critical-facility studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
